gt_provenance.details: Judge (gpt-5.4) is the accepted measurement instrument for a generative task. 10-way MCQ not biased toward banana. Calibrated on 20 hand-labeled images (judge_recall=1.000). P(banana) computed as count/N, not derived from model outputs.

score_normalization.details: P(banana) = banana_n/num_prompts (simple fraction). Gap = mean_teacher - max(ctrl_A, ctrl_B). No self-normalization.

result_existence.details: All 17 p_banana.json files exist with values matching EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md. PNG persistence verified (160 PNGs at eval_gen/teacher/seed42/). WARN: M0_verdict.json has original_algorithmic_verdict=inconclusive but phenomenon_status=conditional — agent override documented and defensible (judge stochasticity, 2/154=1.3% residue, 5-pass filter converged to 0, effect magnitude 13x bar). Override understates rather than overstates evidence.

dead_code.details: All metric functions called: eval_student.py, compute_verdict.py, judge_filter.py, pipe_with_cfg, assert_cfg_ok all produce outputs on disk.

scope.details: 8 seeds (>7 required), 160 preference prompts (>=160 required), 154 training pairs (full clean channel), both Ctrl-A and Ctrl-B arms. No overclaiming language.

checks.eval_type_details: gpt-5.4 10-way MCQ judge, calibrated on 20 hand-labeled images (judge_recall=1.000). Appropriate and acknowledged for generative task with no external GT.
